gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint is anxiety symptoms only. Generated CC includes both anxiety and palpitations lasting two months; the anxiety part and duration appear elsewhere (HPI), but there is no generated fact that captures the CC as simply ‘anxiety symptoms.’

Gold: two‑month history of feeling anxious all the time. Generated hpi-001: anxiety began two months ago after starting a new job. Duration and overall onset of anxiety are captured, though ‘all the time’ is only implied, not explicit.

Gold: anxiety began after starting a new job in a different industry with pressure from boss. Generated hpi-001 mentions new job at a fashion retailer but does not mention different industry or pressure from boss.
Gold: patient dreads going to work every morning. Generated hpi-004: feels dread about going to work. Morning timing is omitted but core concept of dread about going to work is present.
Gold: severe initial insomnia taking about 3 hours to fall asleep. Generated facts mention difficulty falling asleep and poor sleep but do not state the 3‑hour sleep onset latency.

Gold: early‑morning waking. Generated: no explicit EMW, but severely reduced total sleep and poor sleep quality are described without timing. EMW is not specifically captured, so this is better treated as OMITTED.
Gold: often only 3–4 hours sleep per night. Generated hpi-005: average sleep approximately 3 to 4 hours per night. This directly matches.
Gold: patient feels tired during the day. Generated facts describe poor sleep and functional impact but do not explicitly state daytime tiredness.
Gold: patient reports low energy. Generated facts mention low mood and poor sleep but not explicitly low energy.
Gold: eating pattern normal but more chocolate. Generated ros-008/ros-009: no significant change in appetite and increased chocolate intake. This matches.

Gold: anhedonia at work and outside with avoidance of running, tennis, socialising. Generated hpi-008 and ros-003: anxiety impacts enjoyment of day‑to‑day activities and lack of enjoyment in previously enjoyable activities. Specific activities and partial avoidance are omitted but anhedonia concept is captured.

Gold: palpitations began with the anxiety symptoms. Generated hpi-006 and ros-004 describe irregular palpitations but do not specify that onset coincided with anxiety. This temporal link is omitted, so status should be OMITTED rather than COVERED.

Gold: palpitations feel irregular and are accompanied by chest discomfort. Generated: irregular fast heartbeat episodes, and denial of persistent chest pain except during palpitations. The irregularity is captured, but chest discomfort vs. ‘no persistent chest pain except during palpitations’ is not clearly equivalent to ‘chest discomfort’; the gold statement of discomfort is not clearly reproduced.
Gold: palpitations are rapid and last about 2–10 minutes. Generated hpi-006: irregular fast heartbeat episodes lasting a few to ten minutes. This matches duration and rapid/fast nature.
Gold: patient has not missed work. No generated fact addresses work attendance, only work stress and dread.
Gold: public transport is another anxiety trigger. Generated facts do not mention public transport.
Gold: low mood most of the time. Generated ros-002: patient reports low mood. Frequency (‘most of the time’) is omitted but core symptom is present.
Gold: no past psychiatric history or significant anxiety. No generated fact covers past psychiatric history.
Gold: mother has history of depression. Generated fhx-001 states the same.
Gold: lives with supportive parents. Generated sh-001: lives with parents; supportiveness is not mentioned but residence is captured.

Gold: drinks Fri/Sat, sometimes overdoes it. Generated sh-003: drinks socially, especially on weekends, amounts above personal limits during these times. This aligns with weekend use and sometimes overdoing it.
Gold: smokes occasionally. Generated sh-005: occasional smoker. Direct match.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-006: denies drug use. Direct match.
Gold: work‑related anxiety. Generated asm-001: work‑related anxiety disorder impacting sleep and daily functioning. Core assessment is covered, with additional detail.
Gold: insomnia. Generated asm-001 notes anxiety impacting sleep; insomnia as a discrete listed diagnosis is not restated but insomnia is clearly implied. Still reasonably treated as covered.
Gold: advised self‑referral to NHS talking therapies. Generated plan-001: recommend self‑referral via NHS for talking therapy/CBT. Covered.
Gold: advised to access online CBT resources. Generated plan-002 and plan-007: provide/access online resources for anxiety management. CBT label is implicit; online resources for anxiety are covered.

Gold: blood tests as initial investigation for palpitations, to be booked via support team. Generated plan-005 and plan-006: arrange basic blood tests to rule out causes; contact support line to arrange tests. This matches.

Gold: contact clinic if anxiety/mood worsen or unable to cope with work. Generated follow-up focuses on post–blood test visit and general follow up if anxiety worsens, but does not specify inability to cope with work or contacting ‘us for further discussion’ in that context.

Gold: denies suicidal ideation. Generated ROS does not address suicidal ideation.

Gold describes dread of work and anxiety triggers (including public transport) but not specifically ‘nervousness every morning about leaving the house.’ This phrasing is new detail, not contradicted.

Gold: ‘dreads work every morning.’ Generated: ‘feels dread about going to work.’ This is essentially the same idea, without the ‘every morning’ temporal qualifier.

Gold supports average 3–4 hours of sleep (hpi-006) and palpitations, but attributes insomnia to initial insomnia and EMW. ‘Due to racing thoughts and palpitations’ is an additional explanatory detail not in gold.
